trap-nonspeakable.notes: SEPARATE (non-trap) EPISTEMIC finding, and the most consequential thing in this block. 'The Kashaev-Murakami-Murakami theorem confirms this limit equals the hyperbolic volume:' followed by a displayed equality asserted as fact. There is no such theorem: Kashaev (1997) CONJECTURED it and Murakami-Murakami (2001) REFORMULATED the conjecture in terms of the coloured Jones polynomial. This directly contradicts the sibling block conj:kashaev-volume-conjecture.md in the same chapter, which correctly says the statement 'is OPEN in general (proved only for specific families ...)' - and this remark sits inside that conjecture's own uses[] cone, so a conjecture block is citing a remark that asserts the conjecture as proved. FIX: 'The Kashaev-Murakami-Murakami conjecture asserts that this limit equals the hyperbolic volume:' and mark the display as conjectural. Minor second point: calling the coloured Jones at a root of unity 'a purely p-adic/cyclotomic discrete algebraic trace' is loose - it is a cyclotomic integer; nothing p-adic has been introduced.
